integrity: Direct symbolic expansion proves the equivalence; finite exact-force checks are corroboration, not infinite certificates. The four-body rhombus specialization overlaps known work. Source comparisons leave residual risk for older uncatalogued high-dimensional formulations. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to collision-free, full-spanning, equal-mass antipodal pairs in the attractive quartic polynomial-force model. It does not classify arbitrary central configurations, negative-power gravitation, frame feasibility given only weights, or orbital stability. The scalar period follows standard quartic-oscillator reduction and is not represented as independently novel.
title: Spectral tight-frame classification of antipodal quartic N-body oscillations
